# yii3-altcha

Self-hosted ALTCHA proof-of-work CAPTCHA for Yii3, on top of the official `altcha-org/altcha`. The server issues a signed
challenge, the browser solves it, the server verifies locally — no outgoing request, no third-party account.

Install:

```
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-altcha
```

## Rules

- PHP 8.3+, `declare(strict_types=1)`; immutable by default (`final readonly class`)
- The official library owns all cryptography; only `ChallengeIssuer` and `AltchaVerifier` touch it
- `secret` is mandatory, at least 32 bytes, from the environment; an unset secret fails the container
- Challenges always expire (`ttlSeconds`); unsigned challenges never verify (fail-closed)
- `verify()` never throws on hostile input: anything undecodable is `VerificationStatus::Malformed`; payloads over 8192 bytes are `Malformed` before decoding
- Replay protection (default on) needs a `Psr\SimpleCache\CacheInterface` in the container; without it set `replayProtection => false`
- `AltchaRule` handlers are built without arguments by yiisoft/validator: they read the verifier from `AltchaRegistry`, filled by `config/bootstrap.php`
- Proof-of-work raises the cost of automation, it is not proof of a human: combine with rate limiting

## API

Params (`config/params.php`, key `rasuvaeff/yii3-altcha`): `secret`, `algorithm` (`PBKDF2/SHA-256` default; also `PBKDF2/SHA-384|512`, `SHA-256|384|512`),
`cost` (5000, max 1000000), `maxCounter` (1000), `ttlSeconds` (600), `replayProtection` (true), `translation.category`.

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Altcha\{AltchaConfig, AltchaVerifier, ChallengeIssuer, VerificationStatus};

$config = new AltchaConfig(secret: $env['ALTCHA_SECRET']);           // >= 32 bytes
$challenge = (new ChallengeIssuer($config))->issue();                 // array: parameters + signature, for the widget
$verifier = new AltchaVerifier($config, replayCache: $psr16Cache);    // cache optional
$status = $verifier->verify($_POST['altcha'] ?? '');                  // VerificationStatus
$status->isVerified();                                                // true only for Verified
// other cases: Expired, InvalidSignature, InvalidSolution, Replayed, Malformed (->value is snake_case)
```

```php
// Route (PSR-15 handler returning the challenge as uncached JSON)
Route::get('/altcha/challenge')->action(Rasuvaeff\Yii3Altcha\ChallengeAction::class);

// Form: the widget tag (load the altcha web component script yourself, pinned version)
echo Rasuvaeff\Yii3Altcha\AltchaWidget::widget()
    ->withChallengeUrl('/altcha/challenge')
    ->withFieldName('altcha')   // default
    ->render();                 // <altcha-widget challengeurl="/altcha/challenge" name="altcha"></altcha-widget>

// Validation (yiisoft/validator)
final class RegisterForm
{
    #[Rasuvaeff\Yii3Altcha\AltchaRule(message: 'The CAPTCHA verification failed.')]
    public string $altcha = '';
}
```

Algorithms are the `AltchaAlgorithm` enum (values are the protocol names). Difficulty in the browser is about
`cost * maxCounter / 2` key-derivation iterations; tune `maxCounter` first.
